ranking_divisions.equal_risk: each eligible trade receives the frozen 250 USD initial risk before portfolio-capacity constraints
ranking_divisions.capital_constrained: shared capital concurrency exposure and daily-loss constraints apply in deterministic priority order

scoring_events.name: Net expectancy
scoring_events.eligibility: completed trades with finite net PnL and frozen risk
scoring_events.tie_policy: lower maximum drawdown then lexicographic strategy identity

scoring_events.name: Downside-adjusted return
scoring_events.formula: mean(net_R) / sqrt(mean(min(net_R,0)^2)); undefined when downside deviation is zero
scoring_events.eligibility: at least one losing completed trade
scoring_events.tie_policy: higher net expectancy then lexicographic strategy identity

scoring_events.name: Maximum drawdown
scoring_events.formula: maximum peak-to-trough decline of chronological cumulative net_R
scoring_events.tie_policy: higher net expectancy then lexicographic strategy identity

scoring_events.name: Profit factor
scoring_events.formula: sum(positive net PnL) / abs(sum(negative net PnL))
scoring_events.eligibility: at least one winning and one losing completed trade
scoring_events.tie_policy: higher net expectancy then lexicographic strategy identity

scoring_events.name: Payoff ratio
scoring_events.formula: mean(positive net PnL) / abs(mean(negative net PnL))
scoring_events.eligibility: at least one winning and one losing completed trade
scoring_events.tie_policy: higher hit rate then lexicographic strategy identity

scoring_events.name: Hit rate
scoring_events.tie_policy: higher payoff ratio then lexicographic strategy identity

scoring_events.name: Tail-loss control
scoring_events.formula: negative mean of worst 5 percent of net_R trades with nearest-rank tail count
scoring_events.tie_policy: lower maximum drawdown then lexicographic strategy identity

scoring_events.name: Monthly stability
scoring_events.formula: median monthly net expectancy minus median absolute deviation of monthly net expectancy
scoring_events.eligibility: at least three active calendar months each with five completed trades
scoring_events.tie_policy: more active months then lexicographic strategy identity

scoring_events.name: Regime stability
scoring_events.formula: minimum net expectancy across frozen pre-outcome regime labels
scoring_events.eligibility: at least two frozen regimes each with ten completed trades
scoring_events.tie_policy: higher median regime expectancy then lexicographic strategy identity

scoring_events.name: Validation consistency
scoring_events.formula: minimum of discovery and untouched-validation net expectancy minus absolute split expectancy difference
scoring_events.eligibility: frozen strategy with qualifying discovery and untouched validation results
scoring_events.tie_policy: higher validation net expectancy then lexicographic strategy identity

scoring_events.name: One-time holdout consistency
scoring_events.formula: minimum of discovery validation and one-time holdout net expectancy minus maximum pairwise split difference
scoring_events.eligibility: unchanged strategy with qualifying discovery validation and one-time holdout results
scoring_events.tie_policy: higher holdout net expectancy then lexicographic strategy identity

scoring_events.name: Capital efficiency
scoring_events.formula: net PnL divided by time-weighted gross capital deployed
scoring_events.eligibility: finite capital-constrained ledger with positive deployed-capital time
scoring_events.tie_policy: higher capital-constrained net expectancy then lexicographic strategy identity

scoring_events.name: Trade sufficiency
scoring_events.tie_policy: more active dates then lexicographic strategy identity

scoring_events.name: Execution robustness
scoring_events.formula: minimum net expectancy across base costs and frozen 1.5x and 2x cost stress cases
scoring_events.eligibility: all frozen cost stress replays reconcile
scoring_events.tie_policy: higher 2x-cost expectancy then lexicographic strategy identity

scoring_events.name: Parameter sensitivity robustness
scoring_events.formula: minimum net expectancy across the canonical contract and at most two preregistered discrete variants
scoring_events.eligibility: all declared variants execute on identical partitions; canonical-only contracts use canonical expectancy
scoring_events.tie_policy: smaller expectancy range then lexicographic strategy identity

multiple_testing.primary_family: ten canonical Benchmark Division strategy hypotheses
